We're officially at FLL! 🌴

Our newest base at Fort Lauderdale–Hollywood International is open, lobby and all. Here's a look around. If you're on the field, stop by, say hi and have a coffee with us.

240 SW 34th St, Fort Lauderdale · 305-326-3498

Text:
Three generations of aviators, and the founder's first son is named Jet. ✈️

305 SKY started in 2019, but aviation has been in our family for more than 55 years. That's why we treat every aircraft like it belongs to family, and every client like they're part of ours.

Who got you into aviation? Tell us in the comments.
Alt text(s): The 305 SKY crew working together in the hangar under an American flag.

Text:
Happy Friday from the 305 SKY crew! 🇺🇸

15 people across FLL, FXE, Boca Raton and Vero Beach keep our clients' aircraft flying. We'll introduce them one at a time over the coming weeks.

Have a favorite memory with our team? Drop it below.
Alt text(s): The 305 SKY crew in the hangar under an American flag.

Text:
When your aircraft is grounded, the last thing you need is a phone tree. 📞

Call 305 SKY and a real person picks up, often one of the owners. AOG support within 30 miles of FLL, FXE, Boca Raton and Vero Beach.

Save the number: 305-326-3498

Fun fact: every one of our clients has the owners' cell numbers. 🌴

No gatekeepers, no call center. It's how our family has done aviation for three generations.

What's the best customer service you've ever had? Tell us below.

Text:
Friday on the wing. 🛠️

Two of our techs, deep in the details on a King Air. No shortcuts, just care. Happy weekend from the 305 SKY crew!
Alt text(s): Two 305 SKY technicians working on a King Air wing in the hangar.

Text:
Thinking about buying an aircraft? ✈️

A pre-buy inspection is the best money you'll spend before closing. We review the logbooks and the aircraft itself, then give you a clear written report.

Questions? Call us at 305-326-3498, and an owner will pick up.
Alt text(s): The nose of a Challenger jet on the ramp.

Text:
Cabin goals. 🤎

A few of the interiors that have passed through our hangars: hand-stitched leather, quilted panels and every detail finished. Which one is your favorite: 1, 2 or 3?

Text:
Flying in for the boat show this weekend? 🚤✈️

Enjoy the show, and if your aircraft needs anything while you're here, 305 SKY is at FLL and FXE with AOG support within 30 miles. Save the number: 305-326-3498

Text:
Welcome to our Vero Beach hangar! 🌴

More than 12,000 sq ft, with room for jets up to the Global Express inside. If you're on the Treasure Coast, come see us.

Text:
Is your panel ready for the next 20 years? 🛩️

Our Boca Raton team plans and installs Garmin avionics upgrades: glass displays, navigators, autopilots and ADS-B. Every job comes with a written quote first and complete paperwork after.
